messages:
Noah R: Kickoff: ISV/tooling integration checklist for the gateway-orchestrator pilot. Need to land a tiny beta that works with LangChain and LlamaIndex.

Tara V: Agreed. Suggest we scope beta to retrieval QA + reranking flows only to keep perf targets reasonable.

Liam B: Technical constraints: keep API surface identical to gateway-v1. No SDK changes. We'll implement server-side adapter switch.

Cassie M: Marketplace note: screenshots, short demo video, and an audit log sample are mandatory. Azure has extra compliance PDF requirement.

Noah R: Proposed minimal timeline:
- Day 0: internal hookup + smoke tests with LangChain repo sample
- Day 3: SI partner pilot (1 partner) + perf sweep on Ampere
- Day 7: package marketplace artifacts and legal review
- Day 14: soft announcement to early partners

Tara V: Dev checklist:
```
- adapter feature-flag (server-side)
- fallback route to gateway-v1
- observability: traces + token cost metric
- demo app: langchain + llamaindex example
```

Liam B: Rollback plan: flip feature-flag off and shift 100% traffic to gateway-v1 if error rate >2% over 10m. Capture runbook steps.

Cassie M: I'm looping AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace contacts now. Also will request partner logo approval from Orchestrator legal.

marketplace-bot: Heads-up: upload final listing bundle 10 business days before desired publish date. See internal marketplace guide.

Noah R: Action items:
- Liam: feature-flag + fallback implementation (due +4 days)
- Tara: demo app + deterministic prompts (due +5 days)
- Cassie: marketplace owners + legal logo clearance (due EOD)

Tara V: Will open infra ticket for Ampere allocation. Let's keep the first beta small and measurable.

Noah R: Thanks team. I'll draft the joint announcement outline and share with partners after legal signs off.
